inspirations.arabicText: خَيْرُكُمْ مَنْ تَعَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ وَعَلَّمَهُ
inspirations.englishText: The best among you are those who learn the Qur'an and teach it.
inspirations.attribution: Narrated by 'Uthman ibn 'Affan (may Allah be pleased with him)

inspirations.arabicText: تَعَاهَدُوا هَذَا الْقُرْآنَ، فَوَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لَهُوَ أَشَدُّ تَفَلُّتًا مِنَ الإِبِلِ فِي عُقُلِهَا
inspirations.englishText: Keep revising and committing yourselves to this Qur'an; for by the One in Whose Hand is my soul, it slips away faster than camels escaping their hobbles.
inspirations.attribution: Narrated by Abu Musa al-Ash'ari (may Allah be pleased with him)

inspirations.arabicText: وَرَتِّلِ الْقُرْآنَ تَرْتِيلًا
inspirations.englishText: And recite the Qur'an with measured, slow, and melodious recitation.

inspirations.arabicText: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا الذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُ لَحَافِظُونَ
inspirations.englishText: Indeed, it is We who sent down the Qur'an and indeed, We will be its guardian.

inspirations.arabicText: يُقَالُ لِصَاحِبِ الْقُرْآنِ: اقْرَأْ وَارْتَقِ وَرَتِّلْ كَمَا كُنْتَ تُرَتِّلُ فِي الدُّنْيَا، فَإِنَّ مَنْزِلَتَكَ عِنْدَ آخِرِ آيَةٍ تَقْرَؤُهَا
inspirations.englishText: It will be said to the companion of the Qur'an: 'Recite, ascend, and recite carefully as you recited in the world, for your station will be at the last verse you recite.'
inspirations.attribution: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Amr (may Allah be pleased with him)

inspirations.arabicText: الَّذِي يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ وَهُوَ مَاهِرٌ بِهِ مَعَ السَّفَرَةِ الْكِرَامِ الْبَرَرَةِ، وَالَّذِي يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ وَيَتَتَعْتَعُ فِيهِ وَهُوَ عَلَيْهِ شَاقٌّ لَهُ أَجْرَانِ
inspirations.englishText: The one who is skilled in reciting the Qur'an will be with the noble, obedient recording angels; and the one who recites with difficulty, stammering through it, will receive a double reward.
inspirations.attribution: Narrated by 'Aishah (may Allah be pleased with her)

inspirations.arabicText: ينبغي لحامل القرآن أن يُعرف بليله إذا الناس نائمون، وبنهاره إذا الناس مفطرون، وبحزنه إذا الناس يفرحون
inspirations.englishText: The bearer of the Qur'an should be distinguished by his night prayers when people are asleep, by his fasting when people are eating, and by his solemnity when people are heedless.
inspirations.attribution: Abdullah ibn Mas'ud (may Allah be pleased with him)

inspirations.arabicText: أَحَبُّ الأَعْمَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ أَدْوَمُهَا وَإِنْ قَلَّ
inspirations.englishText: The most beloved of deeds to Allah are those that are most consistent, even if they are small.
inspirations.attribution: Narrated by 'Aishah (may Allah be pleased with her)

inspirations.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
inspirations.englishText: And We have indeed made the Qur'an easy to remember and reflect upon, then is there any who will remember?

inspirations.arabicText: كلُّ عِلْمٍ دُونَ القُرْآنِ مَشْغَلَةٌ، إِلاَّ الحَدِيْثَ وَإِلاَّ الفِقْهَ فِي الدِّيْنِ
inspirations.englishText: Every pursuit of knowledge other than the Qur'an is a distraction, except the study of Hadith and deep comprehension of the religion.

inspirations.arabicText: اقْرَؤُوا الْقُرْآنَ فَإِنَّهُ يَأْتِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ شَفِيعًا لِأَصْحَابِهِ
inspirations.englishText: Recite the Qur'an, for it will come on the Day of Resurrection as an intercessor for its devoted companions.
inspirations.attribution: Narrated by Abu Umamah al-Bahili (may Allah be pleased with him)

inspirations.arabicText: ينبغي لحامل القرآن أن يكون رطب اللسان بتلاوته، دائم المدارسة له، لا يغفل عنه يوماً
inspirations.englishText: It is incumbent upon the bearer of the Qur'an to keep his tongue moist with its recitation, to revise it continuously, and not to neglect it for even a single day.
inspirations.attribution: Imam Yahya ibn Sharaf an-Nawawi (d. 676 AH)

inspirations.arabicText: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَتْلُونَ كِتَابَ اللَّهِ وَأَقَامُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَأَنفَقُوا مِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ سِرًّا وَعَلَانِيَةً يَرْجُونَ تِجَارَةً لَّن تَبُورَ
inspirations.englishText: Indeed, those who recite the Book of Allah and establish prayer and spend out of what We have provided them, secretly and openly, anticipate a trade that will never perish.

inspirations.arabicText: وَالأَخْذُ بِالتَّجْوِيدِ حَتْمٌ لازِمُ ... مَنْ لَمْ يُجَوِّدِ الْقُرْآنَ آثِمُ
inspirations.englishText: Observing proper tajweed and precision in recitation is an imperative duty; meticulous care preserves the revelation in its pristine beauty.

inspirations.arabicText: مَنْ قَرَأَ حَرْفًا مِنْ كِتَابِ اللَّهِ فَلَهُ بِهِ حَسَنَةٌ، وَالْحَسَنَةُ بِعَشْرِ أَمْثَالِهَا
inspirations.englishText: Whoever recites a single letter from the Book of Allah receives a good deed, and that good deed is multiplied tenfold.
inspirations.attribution: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn Mas'ud (may Allah be pleased with him)

inspirations.arabicText: الثبات ليس بمحض القوة البشرية، بل بتوفيق الله وإخلاص العبد وتكرار ورده كل صباح ومساء
inspirations.englishText: Steadfastness (Thabāt) is not achieved merely by human strength; it is granted by Allah's divine grace through sincere intention and daily revision morning and evening.

inspirations.arabicText: إذا أردت أن تعلم ما عندك وعند غيرك من محبة الله فانظر محبة القرآن من قلبك
inspirations.englishText: If you wish to discover how much love of Allah resides in your heart, observe the depth of love your heart carries for the Qur'an.

inspirations.arabicText: إِنَّ لِلَّهِ أَهْلِينَ مِنَ النَّاسِ. قَالُوا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَنْ هُمْ؟ قَالَ: هُمْ أَهْلُ الْقُرْآنِ، أَهْلُ اللَّهِ وَخَاصَّتُهُ
inspirations.englishText: Allah has His own chosen elite among mankind. The companions asked: 'Who are they, O Messenger of Allah?' He replied: 'The people of the Qur'an; they are the people of Allah and His elect.'
inspirations.attribution: Narrated by Anas ibn Malik (may Allah be pleased with him)

inspirations.arabicText: وَقَالَ الرَّسُولُ يَا رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِي اتَّخَذُوا هَٰذَا الْقُرْآنَ مَهْجُورًا
inspirations.englishText: And the Messenger said, 'O my Lord, indeed my people took this Qur'an as something abandoned.' Let continuous Muroja'ah guarantee you never abandon its recitation.

inspirations.arabicText: حامل القرآن حامل راية الإسلام، لا ينبغي أن يلهو مع من يلهو، ولا يسهو مع من يسهو
inspirations.englishText: The bearer of the Qur'an carries the noble standard of Islam; it is unfitting for him to indulge in heedless play or trivial pursuits.

inspirations.arabicText: مَنْ اسْتَمَعَ إِلَى آيَةٍ مِنْ كِتَابِ اللَّهِ كُتِبَتْ لَهُ حَسَنَةٌ مُضَاعَفَةٌ، وَمَنْ تَلاَهَا كَانَتْ لَهُ نُورًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
inspirations.englishText: Whoever listens attentively to a verse from the Book of Allah has a multiplied reward written for him; and whoever recites it, it becomes light for him on the Day of Resurrection.

inspirations.arabicText: اتْلُ مَا أُوحِيَ إِلَيْكَ مِنَ الْكِتَابِ وَأَقِمِ الصَّلَاةَ
inspirations.englishText: Recite what has been revealed to you of the Book and establish the prayer.

inspirations.arabicText: مَنْ أَرَادَ عِلْمَ الأَوَّلِينَ وَالآخِرِينَ فَلْيُثَوِّرِ القُرْآنَ، فَإِنَّ فِيهِ عِلْمَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
inspirations.englishText: Whoever seeks the wisdom of the early and later generations should ponder deeply over the Qur'an, for therein lies all fundamental truth.
inspirations.attribution: Abdullah ibn Mas'ud (may Allah be pleased with him)

inspirations.arabicText: النجاح في الحفظ خطوة، والثبات على المراجعة مسيرة حياة
inspirations.englishText: Memorising the Qur'an is a milestone; remaining steadfast in daily revision is the true journey of a lifetime.

inspirations.arabicText: مَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِ الَّذِي يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ مَثَلُ الأُتْرُجَّةِ رِيحُهَا طَيِّبٌ وَطَعْمُهَا طَيِّبٌ
inspirations.englishText: The believer who recites the Qur'an is like a citron: pleasant in scent and delightful in taste.

inspirations.arabicText: وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ مَا هُوَ شِفَاءٌ وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
inspirations.englishText: And We send down of the Qur'an that which is healing and mercy for the believers.

inspirations.arabicText: لا يَزَالُ الرَّجُلُ يَقْرَأُ القُرْآنَ حَتَّى يُعْرَفَ بِهِ فِي النَّاسِ، وَيَأْتِي يَوْمَ القِيَامَةِ وَهُوَ حُجَّةٌ لَهُ
inspirations.englishText: A man continues to recite the Qur'an until he is recognized among the people by it, and he comes on the Day of Judgment with the Qur'an standing as a proof for him.

inspirations.arabicText: كل آية تكررها اليوم بصبر، تشهد لك غداً عند رب العالمين بأنك لم تفرط في الأمانة
inspirations.englishText: Every verse you patiently repeat today will testify tomorrow before the Lord of the worlds that you never squandered the trust.

inspirations.arabicText: مَنْ اسْتَمَعَ إِلَى آيَةٍ مِنْ كِتَابِ اللَّهِ كُتِبَتْ لَهُ حَسَنَةٌ مُضَاعَفَةٌ، وَمَنْ تَلاَهَا كَانَتْ لَهُ نُورًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
inspirations.englishText: Whoever listens attentively to a verse from the Book of Allah has a multiplied reward written for him; and whoever recites it, it becomes light for him on the Day of Resurrection.

inspirations.arabicText: كِتَابٌ أَنزَلْنَاهُ إِلَيْكَ مُبَارَكٌ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوا آيَاتِهِ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُولُو الْأَلْبَابِ
inspirations.englishText: This is a blessed Book which We have sent down to you that they may ponder its verses and that men of understanding may remember.

inspirations.arabicText: تَفَقَّدِ الحَلاوَةَ فِي ثَلاثَةِ أَشْيَاءَ: فِي الصَّلاةِ، وَفِي القُرْآنِ، وَفِي الذِّكْرِ
inspirations.englishText: Seek the true sweetness of faith in three things: in the prayer, in reciting the Qur'an, and in remembering Allah.

inspirations.arabicText: المراجعة ليست عبئاً تثقله الأيام، بل هي واحة روحك وميدان شرفك كحامل لكتاب الله
inspirations.englishText: Revision is not a burden weighed down by days; it is the spiritual oasis and badge of honour for the bearer of Allah's Book.

inspirations.arabicText: مَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِ الَّذِي يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ مَثَلُ الأُتْرُجَّةِ رِيحُهَا طَيِّبٌ وَطَعْمُهَا طَيِّبٌ
inspirations.englishText: The believer who recites the Qur'an is like a citron: pleasant in scent and delightful in taste.

inspirations.arabicText: اللَّهُ نَزَّلَ أَحْسَنَ الْحَدِيثِ كِتَابًا مُّتَشَابِهًا مَّثَانِيَ تَقْشَعِرُّ مِنْهُ جُلُودُ الَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ
inspirations.englishText: Allah has sent down the best statement: a consistent Book wherein is reiteration. The skins shiver therefrom of those who fear their Lord.

inspirations.arabicText: لا يثبت الحفظ في الصدور إلا بكثرة التكرار ومداومة المراجعة بلا انقطاع
inspirations.englishText: Memorisation does not anchor firmly in the chest except through relentless repetition and uninterrupted revision.
inspirations.sourceReference: Sharh Sahih Muslim, Kitab Fadail al-Qur'an

inspirations.arabicText: اليوم الذي لا تراجع فيه وردك تفقد فيه جزءاً من صفاء ذاكرتك، فاجعل المراجعة عهدك الأول كل صباح
inspirations.englishText: The day you miss your revision portion, you forfeit part of your clarity. Make revision your first non-negotiable pledge each morning.

inspirations.arabicText: مَنْ اسْتَمَعَ إِلَى آيَةٍ مِنْ كِتَابِ اللَّهِ كُتِبَتْ لَهُ حَسَنَةٌ مُضَاعَفَةٌ، وَمَنْ تَلاَهَا كَانَتْ لَهُ نُورًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
inspirations.englishText: Whoever listens attentively to a verse from the Book of Allah has a multiplied reward written for him; and whoever recites it, it becomes light for him on the Day of Resurrection.

inspirations.arabicText: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ الْقُرْآنُ فَاسْتَمِعُوا لَهُ وَأَنصِتُوا لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
inspirations.englishText: And when the Qur'an is recited, listen to it and keep silent that you may receive mercy.

inspirations.arabicText: لَوْ طَهُرَتْ قُلُوبُكُمْ مَا شَبِعَتْ مِنْ كَلامِ رَبِّكُمْ
inspirations.englishText: If your hearts were truly purified, they would never become full or tired of reciting the Word of your Lord.
inspirations.attribution: 'Uthman ibn 'Affan (may Allah be pleased with him)

inspirations.arabicText: إذا تعسرت عليك بعض المتشابهات فلا تضجر، فإن مشقة المجاهدة أجر، وتكرار الآيات رفعة وذكر
inspirations.englishText: If similar verses (Mutashabihat) challenge you, do not despair. The struggle itself is a multiplied reward, and repetition elevates your rank.

inspirations.arabicText: مَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِ الَّذِي يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ مَثَلُ الأُتْرُجَّةِ رِيحُهَا طَيِّبٌ وَطَعْمُهَا طَيِّبٌ
inspirations.englishText: The believer who recites the Qur'an is like a citron: pleasant in scent and delightful in taste.

inspirations.arabicText: بَلْ هُوَ آيَاتٌ بَيِّنَاتٌ فِي صُدُورِ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ
inspirations.englishText: Rather, the Qur'an consists of distinct verses preserved within the chests of those endowed with knowledge.

inspirations.arabicText: مَنْ أَرَادَ عِلْمَ الأَوَّلِينَ وَالآخِرِينَ فَلْيُثَوِّرِ القُرْآنَ، فَإِنَّ فِيهِ عِلْمَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
inspirations.englishText: Whoever seeks the wisdom of the early and later generations should ponder deeply over the Qur'an, for therein lies all fundamental truth.

inspirations.englishText: Whoever listens attentively to a verse from the Book of Allah has a multiplied reward written for him; and whoever recites it, it becomes light for him on the Day of Resurrection.

inspirations.arabicText: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ قَدْ جَاءَتْكُم مَّوْعِظَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَشِفَاءٌ لِّمَا فِي الصُّدُورِ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
inspirations.englishText: O mankind, there has come to you instruction from your Lord and healing for what is in the breasts and guidance and mercy for the believers.

inspirations.englishText: Whoever seeks the wisdom of the early and later generations should ponder deeply over the Qur'an, for therein lies all fundamental truth.
inspirations.attribution: Abdullah ibn Mas'ud (may Allah be pleased with him)

inspirations.arabicText: النجاح في الحفظ خطوة، والثبات على المراجعة مسيرة حياة
inspirations.englishText: Memorising the Qur'an is a milestone; remaining steadfast in daily revision is the true journey of a lifetime.

inspirations.arabicText: مَنْ اسْتَمَعَ إِلَى آيَةٍ مِنْ كِتَابِ اللَّهِ كُتِبَتْ لَهُ حَسَنَةٌ مُضَاعَفَةٌ، وَمَنْ تَلاَهَا كَانَتْ لَهُ نُورًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
inspirations.englishText: Whoever listens attentively to a verse from the Book of Allah has a multiplied reward written for him; and whoever recites it, it becomes light for him on the Day of Resurrection.

inspirations.arabicText: وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ مَا هُوَ شِفَاءٌ وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
inspirations.englishText: And We send down of the Qur'an that which is healing and mercy for the believers.

inspirations.arabicText: لا يَزَالُ الرَّجُلُ يَقْرَأُ القُرْآنَ حَتَّى يُعْرَفَ بِهِ فِي النَّاسِ، وَيَأْتِي يَوْمَ القِيَامَةِ وَهُوَ حُجَّةٌ لَهُ
inspirations.englishText: A man continues to recite the Qur'an until he is recognized among the people by it, and he comes on the Day of Judgment with the Qur'an standing as a proof for him.

inspirations.arabicText: كل آية تكررها اليوم بصبر، تشهد لك غداً عند رب العالمين بأنك لم تفرط في الأمانة
inspirations.englishText: Every verse you patiently repeat today will testify tomorrow before the Lord of the worlds that you never squandered the trust.

inspirations.arabicText: مَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِ الَّذِي يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ مَثَلُ الأُتْرُجَّةِ رِيحُهَا طَيِّبٌ وَطَعْمُهَا طَيِّبٌ
inspirations.englishText: The believer who recites the Qur'an is like a citron: pleasant in scent and delightful in taste.

inspirations.arabicText: كِتَابٌ أَنزَلْنَاهُ إِلَيْكَ مُبَارَكٌ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوا آيَاتِهِ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُولُو الْأَلْبَابِ
inspirations.englishText: This is a blessed Book which We have sent down to you that they may ponder its verses and that men of understanding may remember.

inspirations.arabicText: تَفَقَّدِ الحَلاوَةَ فِي ثَلاثَةِ أَشْيَاءَ: فِي الصَّلاةِ، وَفِي القُرْآنِ، وَفِي الذِّكْرِ
inspirations.englishText: Seek the true sweetness of faith in three things: in the prayer, in reciting the Qur'an, and in remembering Allah.

inspirations.arabicText: المراجعة ليست عبئاً تثقله الأيام، بل هي واحة روحك وميدان شرفك كحامل لكتاب الله
inspirations.englishText: Revision is not a burden weighed down by days; it is the spiritual oasis and badge of honour for the bearer of Allah's Book.

inspirations.arabicText: مَنْ اسْتَمَعَ إِلَى آيَةٍ مِنْ كِتَابِ اللَّهِ كُتِبَتْ لَهُ حَسَنَةٌ مُضَاعَفَةٌ، وَمَنْ تَلاَهَا كَانَتْ لَهُ نُورًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
inspirations.englishText: Whoever listens attentively to a verse from the Book of Allah has a multiplied reward written for him; and whoever recites it, it becomes light for him on the Day of Resurrection.

inspirations.arabicText: اللَّهُ نَزَّلَ أَحْسَنَ الْحَدِيثِ كِتَابًا مُّتَشَابِهًا مَّثَانِيَ تَقْشَعِرُّ مِنْهُ جُلُودُ الَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ
inspirations.englishText: Allah has sent down the best statement: a consistent Book wherein is reiteration. The skins shiver therefrom of those who fear their Lord.

inspirations.arabicText: لا يثبت الحفظ في الصدور إلا بكثرة التكرار ومداومة المراجعة بلا انقطاع
inspirations.englishText: Memorisation does not anchor firmly in the chest except through relentless repetition and uninterrupted revision.
inspirations.sourceReference: Sharh Sahih Muslim, Kitab Fadail al-Qur'an

inspirations.arabicText: اليوم الذي لا تراجع فيه وردك تفقد فيه جزءاً من صفاء ذاكرتك، فاجعل المراجعة عهدك الأول كل صباح
inspirations.englishText: The day you miss your revision portion, you forfeit part of your clarity. Make revision your first non-negotiable pledge each morning.

inspirations.arabicText: مَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِ الَّذِي يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ مَثَلُ الأُتْرُجَّةِ رِيحُهَا طَيِّبٌ وَطَعْمُهَا طَيِّبٌ
inspirations.englishText: The believer who recites the Qur'an is like a citron: pleasant in scent and delightful in taste.

inspirations.arabicText: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ الْقُرْآنُ فَاسْتَمِعُوا لَهُ وَأَنصِتُوا لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
inspirations.englishText: And when the Qur'an is recited, listen to it and keep silent that you may receive mercy.

inspirations.arabicText: لَوْ طَهُرَتْ قُلُوبُكُمْ مَا شَبِعَتْ مِنْ كَلامِ رَبِّكُمْ
inspirations.englishText: If your hearts were truly purified, they would never become full or tired of reciting the Word of your Lord.
inspirations.attribution: 'Uthman ibn 'Affan (may Allah be pleased with him)

inspirations.arabicText: إذا تعسرت عليك بعض المتشابهات فلا تضجر، فإن مشقة المجاهدة أجر، وتكرار الآيات رفعة وذكر
inspirations.englishText: If similar verses (Mutashabihat) challenge you, do not despair. The struggle itself is a multiplied reward, and repetition elevates your rank.
